class.name: LatexLabel3D
class.brief_description: Displays a LaTeX formula in a 3D scene.
class.description: Set [member text] to a formula such as [code]\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2+1}}[/code]. [TeXRender] lays out the formula and draws it to a transparent texture. The node displays the texture on a quad facing local [code]+Z[/code]. [member font_size] sets the formula size in pixels and [member pixel_size] converts formula pixels into local 3D units. Texture resolution is capped at 4096 pixels on its longest edge. The node regenerates its mesh from the formula when entering the scene tree or when the text changes.

method.name: get_draw_flag
method.description: Returns whether the specified draw flag is enabled.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the error from the last layout update, or an empty string on success. Formula changes are applied on a deferred update.

method.name: set_draw_flag
method.description: Enables or disables the specified draw flag.
